cut_rules.bench_variation: sets = max(1, sets - CUT_ACCESSORY) wenn CUT_BENCH_VARIATIONS

rules.fail_rule: Bei einem verpassten Pflicht-Wdh das Max des Lifts um 2,5 % senken.

projection.formula: projiziert = R(Testgewicht / Tabelle[Wdh]); nächster Input = Wdh < 2 ? alter Input : R(alt + (projiziert - alt) * Vertrauensfaktor)

week6: Projiziertes Max nehmen und Woche 6 auslassen
Woche 6 als Deload, dann mit projiziertem Max neu starten
coach: Prozent ist Startgewicht, die RIR-/RPE-Grenze hat Vorrang.
Keine verpassten Wdh in W1–4; Top-Sätze W3–4 nicht über RPE 8,5.
Bei stechendem oder zunehmendem Schmerz abbrechen; bei langsamen Aufwärmsätzen 5–10 % runter und letzten Back-off streichen.

days.label: Bench (desired max)  ·  Close Grip Bench PR peak set

groups.note: Week 4 bench: Candito's heavy-weight acclimation block, driven by your DESIRED bench max. On the accessory peak set the prescribed range is 15-20 reps for a single set - a true 20-rep max if possible, 15 as a no-break minimum. After at least 15 reps you may rack the bar and rest as little as possible before squeezing out the remainder; 20 total reps should be completed.
Due to fatigue from the bench sets, optimal performance on these accessory peak sets is not expected - don't be disappointed if you need lighter weight than anticipated.

days.label: Bench (desired max)  ·  Incline DB Press PR peak set

groups.note: I'd rather you choose the maximum weight and hit just 5 sets than the minimum weight for 10 sets. Pick the heaviest weight possible, then do as many sets as you can. If you manage both the max weight and max sets (10) and feel no nagging pain from overuse, then add 5 back-off sets x 3 reps with 80% of your goal max, using extended pauses (3 seconds) on each rep.

weeks.title: Week 5  ·  Testing Week (High Intensity Strength)
weeks.intro: TEST WEEK. Squat, Deadlift and Bench all tested; Squat & Deadlift loads come from the ACTUAL entered 1RM x 97.5%, never the Training Max. Accessory volume is tapered by roughly 40% - generic slots out, Row/OHP/Pull-up at 2 sets @ RPE6.

days.label: SQUAT TEST  ·  Deadlift primer

groups.note: Main Top Set · 98% of entered 1RM  —  TEST: 1 top set @ RPE10, target 2+ reps. It should be highly unlikely to get more than 4 reps here - 2-4 reps is very good. The option to go beyond exists for cases where knee sleeves or a belt were introduced during the program, or form changed enough to allow serious gains.
Main Back-Off · 80% of entered 1RM  —  One light back-off. Skip it entirely if the test set was a grinder.
Main Top Set · 73% of entered 1RM  —  Primer only - deliberately sub-maximal before the deadlift test on Day 3.
Main Back-Off · 68% of entered 1RM  —  Primer volume - keep it easy.
